tool.name: Beacon2 Biosamples
tool.description: retrieve biosamples, and optionally their variants from federated beacons or a self-hosted database
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" #set $filters = $connection.filters beacon2-query entity --entity biosample @PROVIDER_ARGS@ --granularity '$connection.granularity' --limit $connection.pagination.limit --skip $connection.pagination.skip #if str($connection.pagination.sample) --sample $connection.pagination.sample #end if #if str($connection.lookup.mode) == "by_id" --entity-id '$connection.lookup.entity_id' #if str($connection.lookup.nested) != "none" --nested-entity '$connection.lookup.nested' #if str($connection.lookup.nested) == "genomicVariant" and str($connection.lookup.variant_classes) != "None" --variant-classes '${str($connection.lookup.variant_classes)}' #end if #end if #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query entity --entity biosample --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' #if str($connection.mongo_fields.biosampleStatus) --field 'biosampleStatus.label=$connection.mongo_fields.biosampleStatus' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.collectionDate) --field 'collectionDate=$connection.mongo_fields.collectionDate' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.collectionMoment) --field 'collectionMoment=$connection.mongo_fields.collectionMoment' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.identification) --entity-id '$connection.mongo_fields.identification' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.diagnosticMarkers) --field 'diagnosticMarkers.label=$connection.mongo_fields.diagnosticMarkers' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.histologicalDiagnosis) --field 'histologicalDiagnosis.label=$connection.mongo_fields.histologicalDiagnosis' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.obtentionProcedure) --field 'obtentionProcedure.procedureCode.label=$connection.mongo_fields.obtentionProcedure' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.pathologicalStage) --field 'pathologicalStage.label=$connection.mongo_fields.pathologicalStage' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.pathologicalTnmFinding) --field 'pathologicalTnmFinding.label=$connection.mongo_fields.pathologicalTnmFinding' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.featureType) --field 'phenotypicFeatures.featureType.label=$connection.mongo_fields.featureType' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.severity) --field 'phenotypicFeatures.severity.label=$connection.mongo_fields.severity' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.sampleOriginDetail) --field 'sampleOriginDetail.label=$connection.mongo_fields.sampleOriginDetail' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.sampleOriginType) --field 'sampleOriginType.label=$connection.mongo_fields.sampleOriginType' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.sampleProcessing) --field 'sampleProcessing.label=$connection.mongo_fields.sampleProcessing' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.sampleStorage) --field 'sampleStorage.label=$connection.mongo_fields.sampleStorage' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.tumorGrade) --field 'tumorGrade.label=$connection.mongo_fields.tumorGrade' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.tumorProgression) --field 'tumorProgression.label=$connection.mongo_fields.tumorProgression' #end if @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.name: entity_id
param.label: Identifier
param.help: As used by that beacon. Identifiers are local to each beacon.

param.name: nested
param.label: Also retrieve
param.help: Fetched in one request by the beacon, not assembled here from separate queries.
param.option: All variants observed in this biosample

param.name: variant_classes
param.label: Variant classes (only used when retrieving variants)

section.name: mongo_fields
section.title: Fields to match (each one exact; all must match)

param.name: biosampleStatus
param.label: BIOSAMPLE STATUS
param.help: Ontology value for the classification of the sample in abnormal sample (EFO:0009655) or reference sample (EFO:0009654) Matched exactly against biosampleStatus.label.

param.name: collectionDate
param.label: COLLECTION DATE
param.help: Date of biosample collection in ISO8601 format Matched exactly against collectionDate.

param.name: collectionMoment
param.label: COLLECTION MOMENT
param.help: Individual's or cell culture age at the time of sample collection in the ISO8601 duration format P[n]Y[n]M[n]DT[n]H[n]M[n]S, e.g. P32Y6M1D, P7D Matched exactly against collectionMoment.

param.name: identification
param.label: ID
param.help: Biosample identifier (external accession or internal ID)

param.name: diagnosticMarkers
param.label: DIAGNOSTIC MARKERS
param.help: Clinically relevant bio markers, e.g. T2b Stage Finding Matched exactly against diagnosticMarkers.label. Note: declared but ignored by 2.2.4: never added to its query.

param.name: histologicalDiagnosis
param.label: HISTOLOGICAL DIAGNOSIS
param.help: Disease diagnosis that was inferred from the histological examination, e.g. Serous Cystadenocarcinoma Matched exactly against histologicalDiagnosis.label.

param.name: obtentionProcedure
param.label: OBTENTION PROCEDURE
param.help: Ontology value describing the procedure for sample obtention, e.g. biopsy Matched exactly against obtentionProcedure.procedureCode.label.

param.name: pathologicalStage
param.label: PATHOLOGICAL STAGE
param.help: Pathological stage, if applicable, e.g. Stage IIIA Matched exactly against pathologicalStage.label.

param.name: pathologicalTnmFinding
param.label: PATHOLOGICAL TNM FINDING
param.help: T2b Stage Finding Matched exactly against pathologicalTnmFinding.label.

param.name: featureType
param.label: FEATURE TYPE
param.help: Definition of an ontology term which describes the phenotype, e.g. Infantile spasms Matched exactly against phenotypicFeatures.featureType.label.

param.name: severity
param.label: SEVERITY
param.help: Ontology class that describes the severity of the condition, e.g. Moderate Matched exactly against phenotypicFeatures.severity.label.

param.name: sampleOriginDetail
param.label: SAMPLE ORIGIN DETAIL
param.help: Tissue from which the sample was taken or sample origin matching the category set in 'sampleOriginType', e.g. wall of urinary bladder Matched exactly against sampleOriginDetail.label.

param.name: sampleOriginType
param.label: SAMPLE ORIGIN TYPE
param.help: Category of sample origin. Value from Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI) material entity, e.g abnormal sample Matched exactly against sampleOriginType.label.

param.name: sampleProcessing
param.label: SAMPLE PROCESSING
param.help: Status of how the specimen was processed, e.g. mechanical dissociation Matched exactly against sampleProcessing.label.

param.name: sampleStorage
param.label: SAMPLE STORAGE
param.help: Status of how the specimen was stored Matched exactly against sampleStorage.label.

param.name: tumorGrade
param.label: TUMOR GRADE
param.help: Term representing the tumor grade, e.g. Grade 3a Matched exactly against tumorGrade.label.

param.name: tumorProgression
param.label: TUMOR PROGRESSION
param.help: Tumor progression category indicating primary, metastatic or recurrent progression, e.g. Primary Malignant Neoplasm Matched exactly against tumorProgression.label.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Retrieves biosample records from the beacons you select, or from a self-hosted Beacon MongoDB database.
**Two ways to narrow a query, one per connection**
On the *Beacon v2 API* the tool takes **filters**: ontology terms such as ``NCIT:C3058``, which each beacon maps onto its own records. The API has no way to match a field's value directly.
On a *self-hosted MongoDB* the tool takes **fields**: the same named fields the 2.2.x tools offered, each matched exactly against a document path shown in its help. A raw collection has no mapping from ontology terms to fields, so filters are not offered there.
@HELP_OUTPUTS@
